jobs.title: Business Development Manager CEE&MEA
jobs.description:
About the role

The Business Development Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving and executing the premium powder growth agenda across the Central Eastern Europe and Middle East Africa region. This position identifies, develops, and secures high-value business opportunities in both existing and emerging markets, ensuring sustainable and profitable growth. Acting as a trusted thought partner to the Global Cocoa and Chocolate teams, the Business Development Manager plays a key role in shaping the region’s long-term growth strategy, strengthening market positioning, and translating strategic priorities into actionable business development initiatives aligned with Global Cocoa and broader Group objectives.

Key Responsibilities Include

Strategic Growth Leadership

• Define and execute premium powder growth agenda across the region (defining right product/customer mix with sales teams)

• Anticipate market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics, translating them into actionable strategies with cross-functions (R&D, QA, Supply Chain)

Business Continuity

• Coordinate powder activities across teams and regions, acting as a bridge between sales and internal stakeholders

• Develop a strong network of contacts within the Group - Customer Care, Marketing, Sourcing, Finance and Supply Chain - in order to support day to day business in the region and pro-actively supports the sales team, distributors & customers

• Lead cross-functional initiatives to penetrate high-potential customer segments and geographies (alignment with Chocolate)

Market Dynamics and Analysis

• Utilize data and other functional tools to research potential territories and markets, preparing reports with findings and recommendations

• Understanding regional dynamics and presenting comprehensive demand per sub-region annually are the essentials of the role (lead workshops on competition landscape, market sizing and consumption trends)

Best Practices Implementation:

• Build strong relationships with counterparts within Global Cocoa and Chocolate Regions and introduce best practices to the region from internal and external sources

About You

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Industrial & Food Engineering

• 10+ years in sales, business development or related commercial leadership roles, ideally within global or complex markets (experience in B2B, Food industry is preferred)

• Expertise in structuring and negotiating complex commercial agreements and partnerships

• Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical capability, and financial acumen

• Strong understanding of market dynamics and sales processes

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams

• Fluent in English; speaking French is preferred due to the region’s customer base or and any other language in the region

• Regular travel within region and to BC locations (Louviers, Hamburg, Zurich) required (on average 40% of work time)

• Strategic planning and execution

• Project management

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Business Development Manager è un ruolo di leadership strategica responsabile per la guida e l'esecuzione del programma di crescita della polvere premium in tutta la regione. Questa posizione identifica, sviluppa e garantisce opportunità di business di alto valore sia nei mercati esistenti che emergenti, garantendo una crescita sostenibile e redditizia. Essendo un partner di fiducia nei team Global Cocoa e Chocolate, il Business Development Manager svolge un ruolo chiave nella definizione della strategia di crescita a lungo termine della regione, nel rafforzamento del posizionamento del mercato e nella traduzione di priorità strategiche in iniziative di sviluppo aziendale attuabili allineate con Global Cocoa e obiettivi di Gruppo più ampi.

Responsabilità chiave

Leadership strategica della crescita

• Definire ed eseguire l'agenda di crescita della polvere premium in tutta la regione (definire il giusto mix di prodotti / clienti con i team di vendita)

• Tendenze di mercato anticipate, esigenze dei clienti e dinamiche competitive, traducendoli in strategie attuabili con funzioni incrociate (R&D, QA, Supply Chain)

Continuità aziendale

• Coordinare le attività in polvere in team e regioni, fungendo da ponte tra le vendite e gli stakeholder interni

• Sviluppare una forte rete di contatti all'interno del Gruppo - Customer Care, Marketing, Sourcing, Finanza e Supply Chain - al fine di supportare il business di giorno in giorno nella regione e supporta pro-attivamente il team di vendita, distributori e clienti

• Condurre iniziative interfunzionali per penetrare segmenti e geografie ad alto potenziale del cliente (allineamento con il cioccolato)

Dinamica e Analisi del mercato

• Utilizzare i dati e altri strumenti funzionali per la ricerca di potenziali territori e mercati, preparando rapporti con i risultati e le raccomandazioni

• Comprendere le dinamiche regionali e presentare una domanda globale per sotto-regione ogni anno sono gli elementi essenziali del ruolo (fornire workshop sul paesaggio della concorrenza, sul dimensionamento del mercato e sulle tendenze dei consumi)

Attuazione delle migliori pratiche:

• Costruire relazioni forti con le controparti all'interno del Global Cocoa e delle Regioni del Cioccolato e introdurre le migliori pratiche per la regione da fonti interne ed esterne

A proposito di te

• Laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria industriale e alimentare

• 10+ anni di vendite, sviluppo aziendale o relativi ruoli di leadership commerciale, idealmente all'interno di mercati globali o complessi (l'esperienza in B2B, industria alimentare è preferito)

• Competenza nella strutturazione e nella negoziazione di complessi accordi commerciali e partenariati

• pensiero strategico eccezionale, capacità analitiche e acume finanziario

• Forte comprensione delle dinamiche di mercato e dei processi di vendita

• Capacità di guidare e collaborare con team interfunzionali

• Fluente in inglese; parlare francese è preferito a causa della base clienti della regione o qualsiasi altra languange nella regione

• Viaggi regolari all'interno della regione e nelle località BC (Louviers, Amburgo, Zurigo) richiesto (in media il 40% del tempo di lavoro)

• Pianificazione strategica ed esecuzione

• Gestione dei progetti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle

Der Business Development Manager ist eine strategische Führungsrolle, die für die Förderung und Umsetzung der Premium-Pulverwachstumsagenda in der gesamten Region verantwortlich ist. Diese Position identifiziert, entwickelt und sichert hochwertige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in bestehenden und aufstrebenden Märkten und sorgt für nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum. Als vertrauenswürdiger Vordenker der Global Cocoa and Chocolate Teams spielt der Business Development Manager eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der langfristigen Wachstumsstrategie der Region, der Stärkung der Marktpositionierung und der Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten in umsetzbare Geschäftsentwicklungsinitiativen, die auf Global Cocoa und breitere Konzernziele ausgerichtet sind.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören

Strategische Wachstumsführung

• Definieren und Umsetzung der Premium-Pulverwachstumsagenda in der gesamten Region (Definieren des richtigen Produkt- / Kundenmixes mit Vertriebsteams)

• Antizipieren Sie Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnisse und Wettbewerbsdynamiken und übersetzen Sie sie in umsetzbare Strategien mit funktionsübergreifenden Strategien (R & D, QA, Supply Chain)

Business Continuity

• Koordination von Pulveraktivitäten über Teams und Regionen hinweg, als Brücke zwischen Vertrieb und internen Stakeholdern

• Aufbau eines starken Netzwerks von Kontakten innerhalb der Gruppe - Customer Care, Marketing, Sourcing, Finance und Supply Chain - zur Unterstützung des Tagesgeschäfts in der Region und zur proaktiven Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams, der Distributoren und Kunden

• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen, um Kundensegmente und Regionen mit hohem Potenzial zu erschließen (Ausrichtung mit Chocolate)

Marktdynamik und Analyse

• Verwenden Sie Daten und andere funktionale Werkzeuge, um potenzielle Gebiete und Märkte zu erforschen, und erstellen Sie Berichte mit Ergebnissen und Empfehlungen

• Regionale Dynamik zu verstehen und eine umfassende Nachfrage pro Subregion jährlich zu präsentieren, sind das Wesentliche der Rolle (Leitworkshops zu Wettbewerbslandschaft, Marktgröße und Konsumtrends)

Umsetzung von Best Practices:

• Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Kollegen in den globalen Kakao- und Schokoladenregionen und Einführung von Best Practices aus internen und externen Quellen in die Region

Über dich

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business Administration, Industrial & Food Engineering

• 10+ Jahre in Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung oder verwandten kommerziellen Führungspositionen, idealerweise in globalen oder komplexen Märkten (Erfahrung in B2B, Lebensmittelindustrie wird bevorzugt)

• Expertise in der Strukturierung und Verhandlung komplexer Handelsvereinbarungen und Partnerschaften

• Außergewöhnliches strategisches Denken, analytische Fähigkeiten und finanzieller Scharfsinn

• Starkes Verständnis von Marktdynamik und Verkaufsprozessen

• Fähigkeit zur Führung und Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams

• Fließend in Englisch; Französisch sprechen wird aufgrund der Kundenbasis der Region oder anderer Probleme in der Region bevorzugt

• Regelmäßige Reisen innerhalb der Region und zu BC-Standorten (Louviers, Hamburg, Zürich) erforderlich (durchschnittlich 40% der Arbeitszeit)

• Strategische Planung und Durchführung

• Projektmanagement
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le rôle

Le directeur du développement des affaires est un chef de file stratégique chargé de diriger et d'exécuter le programme de croissance des poudres premium dans toute la région. Cette position identifie, développe et garantit des débouchés commerciaux de grande valeur sur les marchés existants et émergents, assurant ainsi une croissance durable et rentable. En tant que partenaire de confiance des équipes Global Cocoa et Chocolate, le Business Development Manager joue un rôle clé dans l'élaboration de la stratégie de croissance à long terme de la région, le renforcement du positionnement du marché et la traduction des priorités stratégiques en initiatives de développement des entreprises réalisables, alignées sur Global Cocoa et les objectifs plus larges du Groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Leadership stratégique de la croissance

• Définir et exécuter un programme de croissance des poudres premium dans toute la région (définir le bon mélange produit/client avec les équipes de vente)

• Anticiper les tendances du marché, les besoins des clients et la dynamique concurrentielle, les traduire en stratégies réalisables avec des fonctions croisées (R-D, AQ, chaîne d'approvisionnement)

Continuité des activités

• Coordonner les activités relatives aux poudres entre les équipes et les régions, en faisant le lien entre les ventes et les intervenants internes

• Développer un solide réseau de contacts au sein du Groupe - Service à la clientèle, Marketing, Sourcing, Finance et Supply Chain - afin de soutenir les affaires quotidiennes dans la région et soutient activement l'équipe de vente, les distributeurs et les clients

• Diriger les initiatives interfonctionnelles pour pénétrer les segments et les géographies des clients à haut potentiel (alignement avec le chocolat)

Dynamique du marché et analyse

• Utiliser des données et d'autres outils fonctionnels pour la recherche sur les territoires et les marchés potentiels, préparer des rapports assortis de conclusions et de recommandations

• Comprendre la dynamique régionale et présenter chaque année une demande globale par sous-région sont les éléments essentiels du rôle (ateliers de référence sur le paysage de la concurrence, le dimensionnement du marché et les tendances de la consommation)

Mise en oeuvre des pratiques exemplaires :

• Établir des relations solides avec les homologues des régions mondiales du cacao et du chocolat et introduire les meilleures pratiques dans la région à partir de sources internes et externes

À propos de toi

• Licence en administration des affaires, génie industriel et alimentaire

• 10 ans et plus dans les ventes, le développement des affaires ou les rôles de leader commercial connexes, idéalement sur les marchés mondiaux ou complexes (l'expérience en B2B, l'industrie alimentaire est préférée)

• Expertise dans la structuration et la négociation d'accords et de partenariats commerciaux complexes

• Pensée stratégique exceptionnelle, capacité analytique et acuité financière

• Une bonne compréhension de la dynamique du marché et des processus de vente

• Capacité de diriger et de collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles

• Fluent en anglais; parler français est préféré en raison de la clientèle de la région ou de tout autre language dans la région

• Voyages réguliers à l'intérieur de la région et en Colombie-Britannique (Louviers, Hambourg, Zurich) requis (en moyenne 40% du temps de travail)

• Planification stratégique et exécution

• Gestion de projet

jobs.title: Executive Assistant CPCO
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Executive Assistant to the Chief People & Culture Officer (CPCO) and VP Global Total Reward provides high level administrative and organizational support to enable effective leadership and smooth daily operations. Serving as a trusted partner, this role ensures efficient coordination, clear communication, and strong stakeholder engagement.

Beyond supporting the CPCO, the Executive Assistant leads the Zurich Assistant Network, driving best practices, mentoring peers, and acting as a central coordination point for internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

Executive Support

• Manage and optimize the CPCO’s agenda, ensuring time is allocated to the highest value priorities

• Coordinate complex meeting scheduling, prepare briefing materials, and ensure timely follow ups

• Handle all travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, transportation, and visa requirements

• Manage invoices, vendor setup, and expense reporting for the CPCO

• Prepare materials, presentations, and documentation for internal and external engagements

Stakeholder & Communication Management

• Serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders

• Build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization

• Ensure clear, timely, and effective communication between the CPCO, leadership teams, and key partners

• Maintain the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive HR and organizational matters

Operational & Team Support

• Organization of the annual Chairman’s Awards

• Support the organization of team events, leadership meetings and offsites

• Coordinate onboarding for newcomers, including agendas and integration support

• Track key deliverables, follow up on action items, and help drive operational excellence within the HRLT

Leadership within the Assistant Community

• Lead the Zurich Assistant Network, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement

• Mentor peers, share best practices, and contribute to building a strong, cohesive assistant community

• Act as a central coordination point for assistants supporting leaders

About You

• Commercial apprenticeship with further education as an Executive Assistant (Direktionsassistentin) or equivalent

• Minimum 7–10 years of experience supporting senior executives in fast‑paced, multinational environments

• Demonstrated experience supporting C‑suite leaders, ideally within HR or people‑centric functions

• Fluent in German and/or Swiss German and English; additional languages are an asset

• Strong IT proficiency, particularly in the Microsoft 365 environment

• Experience working in complex, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders

• Experience with Concur, SAP, SuccessFactors, and ServiceNow

• Familiarity with HR processes, terminology, and organizational dynamics

• Experience leading or contributing to an assistant network or community of practice

About you

Barry Callebaut’s “Forever Chocolate” strategy includes strong commitments towards climate change and forest protection. Corresponding objectives have specifically been formalized to reflect Barry Callebaut’s ambition to prevent deforestation in the Group’s raw materials’ supply chains and reduce carbon emissions:

• By 2025, to be forest positive

• By 2030, we will have decarbonized our footprint in line with global efforts to cap global warming at 1.5 degrees Celsius

• By 2050, we will be a net-zero company

Barry Callebaut’s strategy to reach the aforementioned “Forest Positive” targets and comply with upcoming European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) encompasses a set of tools to carry out BC’s due diligence obligations, as well as Forest Protection objectives. These tools and programs will enable the Group to claim volumes imported in Europe from 2025 onwards are “deforestation-free” and EUDR compliant. This role ensures that Barry Callebaut has best-in-class deforestation monitoring and geospatial risk intelligence capabilities to support compliant, deforestation-free and legal sourcing as well as proactive risk management. Within this framework, the Forest Risk & Monitoring Manager will oversee the governance, performance and continuous improvement of deforestation monitoring tools and procedures.

Key Responsibilities include

• Farm Deforestation and Legality Due Diligence:

• Oversee and maintain global governance and local SOPs including clear roles and responsibilities for deforestation monitoring and legality assessments

• Liaise with Digital, traceability and MEL teams to ensure seamless integration and data flows between BC’s deforestation and legality monitoring platform and relevant data collection tools

• Monitor market developments in geospatial analytics, satellite monitoring, and deforestation risk modelling

• Evaluate new tools, methodologies, and data sources to enhance current solutions

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Cocoa GCA Pricing & Position Manager to join our team in Zürich. In this role, you will be at the center of Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa business, leading the execution of position management, risk exposure monitoring and cocoa pricing for strategic Global Corporate Account (GCA) agreements.

You will combine strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen to translate complex market movements, position exposures and customer requirements into actionable decisions. Working closely with Trading, Risk Management, Sales, Finance, Operations and regional pricing teams, you will ensure accurate position tracking, effective hedging, robust contract execution and competitive pricing strategies.

As the owner of key position management activities, you will oversee global cocoa exposures, support hedging execution and contribute to risk optimization across regions and systems. At the same time, you will act as a trusted partner to customers and internal stakeholders, helping to develop pricing solutions, manage commercial agreements and support strategic business decisions.

You will gain deep visibility into Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa network (from origin sourcing to customer delivery) and develop a strong understanding of global cocoa flows, supply chain dynamics and market interdependencies. Your insights will help strengthen the connection between our Cocoa and Chocolate businesses by providing market intelligence that supports commercial and pricing decisions across the value chain.

Beyond day-to-day execution, you will have the opportunity to contribute to global projects, process improvements and digitalization initiatives that enhance transparency, efficiency and decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities include

• Lead the execution and monitoring of global cocoa positions, ensuring accurate exposure management, position reconciliation and alignment with hedging and risk management strategies.

• Own end-to-end position management activities, including volume consolidation, position calculations, synthetic exposure management, terminal market hedging and internal risk transfers.

• Monitor and analyze market exposures, financial impacts and risk positions, providing actionable insights to Trading, Risk Management and commercial teams.

• Execute cocoa pricing activities for Global Corporate Account agreements, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant contract implementation.

• Act as a central partner for customers and internal stakeholders by aligning on pricing strategies, position impacts and commercial execution requirements.

• Manage contract portfolios across assigned customers, including bookings, amendments, extensions, balance reconciliations, intercompany contracts and terminal market adjustments.

• Support daily hedging activities and ensure all relevant risk components are accurately reflected across systems, contracts and reporting tools.

• Drive market quotations and ad-hoc pricing requests, supporting sales teams with competitive, commercially sound and risk-aligned proposals.

• Develop pricing solutions for new products, customer agreements, certifications, origins and supply flows while ensuring commercial viability and effective risk management.

• Analyze forecasted, contracted and delivered volumes to support forecasting, budgeting, demand planning and commercial decision-making.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement, acting as a key contact for pricing, contract execution and market-related discussions.

• Drive continuous process improvement by enhancing reporting, increasing transparency, strengthening controls and supporting automation initiatives.

• Contribute to global projects related to cost optimization, flow optimization, contingency planning, supply chain efficiency and business performance improvement.

About You

• 5+ years of experience in commodity trading, position management, pricing, sales or risk management.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex market, position and financial data and translate it into meaningful business insights.

• Solid understanding of hedging principles, futures markets and commodity risk management.

• Commercially minded with the ability to balance market dynamics, customer needs and business objectives.

• Comfortable working independently while also being a collaborative team player in a global environment.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders across functions and regions.

• Cocoa market expertise, including futures markets, bean origins, cocoa products and pricing mechanisms, is highly valued.

• Good understanding of supply chain and logistics, including Incoterms, contract structures and global cocoa flows.

• Experience with SAP, BW and data analysis tools is an advantage.

• Curious, proactive and continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, increase transparency and create value through data-driven decision-making.

• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di mercato, gli impatti finanziari e le posizioni di rischio, fornendo informazioni attuabili su Trading, Risk Management e team commerciali.
• Eseguire le attività di prezzi del cacao per gli accordi di Global Corporate Account, assicurando l'implementazione accurata, tempestiva e conforme del contratto.
• Agire come partner centrale per i clienti e le parti interessate interne allineando sulle strategie di prezzi, gli impatti di posizione e i requisiti di esecuzione commerciale.
• Gestisci i portafogli dei contratti tra i clienti assegnati, incluse prenotazioni, modifiche, ampliamenti, conciliazioni di bilancio, contratti intercompany e modifiche del mercato dei terminali.
• Sostenere le attività di copertura quotidiana e garantire che tutti i componenti di rischio pertinenti siano accuratamente riflessi su sistemi, contratti e strumenti di reporting.
• Le quotazioni sul mercato dell'azionamento e le richieste di prezzi ad-hoc, sostenendo i team di vendita con proposte competitive, commercialmente solide e allineate al rischio.
• Sviluppare soluzioni tariffarie per nuovi prodotti, accordi con i clienti, certificazioni, origini e flussi di approvvigionamento, garantendo al contempo la redditività commerciale e l'efficace gestione dei rischi.
• Analizzare i volumi previsti, contratti e consegnati per sostenere la previsione, il bilancio, la pianificazione della domanda e il processo decisionale commerciale.
• Costruire forti relazioni con i clienti attraverso un impegno regolare, agendo come un contatto chiave per i prezzi, l'esecuzione dei contratti e le discussioni sul mercato.
• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo dei processi migliorando la reportistica, aumentando la trasparenza, rafforzando i controlli e sostenendo le iniziative di automazione.
• Contribuisci a progetti globali relativi all'ottimizzazione dei costi, all'ottimizzazione del flusso, alla pianificazione della contingenza, all'efficienza della supply chain e al miglioramento delle prestazioni aziendali. A proposito di te
• 5+ anni di esperienza nel commercio delle materie prime, nella gestione delle posizioni, nei prezzi, nelle vendite o nella gestione dei rischi.
• Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di interpretare il mercato complesso, la posizione e i dati finanziari e tradurlo in approfondimenti aziendali significativi.
• Una solida comprensione dei principi di copertura, dei mercati dei futures e della gestione del rischio delle materie prime.
• Commercialmente pensato con la capacità di bilanciare le dinamiche del mercato, le esigenze del cliente e gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Confortevole lavorare in modo indipendente mentre è anche un team player collaborativo in un ambiente globale.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con fluenza in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.
• Esperienza di costruire relazioni efficaci con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni attraverso funzioni e regioni.
• L'esperienza del mercato del cacao, compresi i mercati del futuro, le origini dei fagioli, i prodotti del cacao e i meccanismi dei prezzi, è altamente apprezzata.
• Buona comprensione della supply chain e della logistica, tra cui Incoterms, strutture contrattuali e flussi di cacao globali.
• L'esperienza con gli strumenti SAP, BW e analisi dei dati è un vantaggio.
• Curioso, proattivo e continuamente alla ricerca di opportunità per migliorare i processi, aumentare la trasparenza e creare valore attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati.

jobs.description:
About the role

The role of Manager Group Accounting and Reporting (GAR) plays a crucial role in ensuring high‑quality financial reporting, technical accounting compliance, and consistent application of IFRS across the Group. The role strengthens the integrity of consolidated financial information, drives alignment of accounting practices globally, and provide expert guidance on complex accounting matters. This position partners closely with regional finance teams, the Group consolidation function, and cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver accurate reporting, strong governance, and continuous improvement of Group‑wide accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Act as the Group’s IFRS technical expert, supporting regional and local teams on complex accounting topics and new standards

• Specific focus on financial instruments, fair valuation and hedge accounting: IFRS compliance, systems and processes

• Prepare robust accounting documentation, policies and position papers for complex transactions and significant accounting areas

• Develop and maintain Group accounting policies, reporting guidelines, and best practices to ensure consistent application across entities

• Partner with the Group consolidation team to ensure a smooth, timely, and accurate period close

• Build and maintain a strong internal network across regions and functions (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal) to support Group‑wide initiatives

• Support transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and process optimization projects within Group Finance

• Provide high‑quality internal reporting and analytical insights on consolidated results to senior management

• Contribute to the preparation of external disclosures for the Annual Report, Half‑Year Report, and other regulatory filings

• Monitor emerging IFRS developments and assess their impact on the Group

About You

• Minimum 7 years in a professional accounting firm (Big 4 a plus) or multinational/listed company environment

• Exceptional knowledge of technical accounting under IFRS (formulating policy, drafting memos and compliance in practice)

• Expertise and experience in accounting for commodities and derivatives, fair valuation and hedge accounting

• Experience in a global team and external reporting for a listed (preferably SIX) entity

• Demonstrates very positive attitude in a dynamic, matrix and multi-country business environment

• Knowledge of SAP ERP and Group consolidation systems

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and standard business applications

• Applied data-driven mindset in leveraging BI tools for financial insights and reporting optimization

• Agent of change in technical, process and system implementation of fair valuation and hedge accounting policies and best practice

• Curiosity and intellectual agility to navigate complex accounting topics

About the role

As a Packaging Category Manager you will be tasked with accurately procuring packaging materials at the best overall value ready for production, ensuring that quality, cost and delivery are all balanced. You will be working with suppliers covering all aspects of the purchase from putting commercial terms in place to ensuring that packaging materials are delivered as per agreed conditions. You will be managing the strategic sourcing process for specific assigned categories of packaging materials over Barry Callebaut sites primarily in Europe and Africa, as well as globally, according to the defined strategies and drive to increasingly incorporate best in class techniques and industry benchmarks.

Key responsibilities include

• Prepare & implement the sourcing category strategy for the materials in scope, in close collaboration with the category buyers team and Packaging Sourcing Director, to make sure that purchasing goals are well achieved, according to the business priorities, Group policies and principles.

Sur le rôle En tant que gestionnaire de catégorie d'emballage, vous serez chargé d'acheter avec précision les matériaux d'emballage à la meilleure valeur globale prête à la production, en veillant à ce que la qualité, le coût et la livraison soient tous équilibrés. Vous travaillerez avec des fournisseurs couvrant tous les aspects de l'achat en mettant en place des conditions commerciales pour s'assurer que les matériaux d'emballage sont livrés selon les conditions convenues. Les principales responsabilités comprennent :
• Préparer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de catégorie d'approvisionnement pour les matériaux de portée, en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'acheteurs de la catégorie et le directeur de l'approvisionnement d'emballage, afin de s'assurer que les objectifs d'achat sont bien atteints, conformément aux priorités commerciales, aux politiques et aux principes du Groupe.

• Assurer une gestion appropriée des risques, des capacités et des plans d'urgence pour les domaines de responsabilité respectifs.

We are looking for a part-time (60%) management assistant to provide valuable support to the VP of Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, located at our Head Office in Zurich. Additionally, this role is part of the broader Zurich Assistant Network, whose aim is to exchange best practices, deepen the knowledge of business topics, develop skills and provide mutual support to enable our senior leaders reach their business objectives.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Proactive management of the VP’s agenda to ensure structure and optimal use of time, coordinate and schedule meetings across global time zones, prepare agendas, ensure follow-up as needed.

• Complex international travel arrangements (booking flight, hotel, transportation, request visas, etc.)

• Prioritizing conflicting needs, proactively addressing issues, managing competing priorities and ensuring reliable follow-through to resolution

• Support with the creation, formatting, and maintenance of PowerPoint, Word, and Excel documents as needed

• Vendor management (vendor set-up, PO creation and approvals, code and approve invoices)

• Expenses management (submit expense report, approve expenses) and vacation approvals for the team

• Support on-boarding of new team members (coordinate on-boarding agenda, help with materials, training schedule, etc.)

• Build efficient and professional working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, act as a first point of contact

• Support in event organization (team events, activities & dinners) and presents (Birthday, Christmas, anniversaries, etc.)

• Support with the annual general meeting of shareholders

About You

• Ideally 5+ years of experience as a Management or Executive Assistant in a similar role in an international environment

• Familiarity with Corporate Communications related topics, experience in those departments is a plus

• Appropriate vocational or University training (either in business/ economics, as a management/ executive assistant, or related field)

• Proficient in English, German language knowledge a big plus, other languages are an advantage

• Strong computer literacy with experience of full Microsoft Suite, Success Factors, SAP, Concur, and ServiceNow preferred

• Ability to organize, multi-task, and work under pressure

• Passionate, quick thinker, creative and an effective problem solver

• Ability to prioritize and switch between tasks to meet deadlines

• Great communicator, service-oriented mindset and attitude, proactive with a can-do attitude

• Highly organized with an independent and efficient way of working

• Strong stakeholder management - experience in interacting with people of all levels in the organization

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Manager - FM & Specialties
jobs.description:
About the Role

Barry Callebaut’s future relies on strengthening customer trust while navigating shifting markets and rapid technological change. To achieve this, we are sharpening a unified Customer Experience (CX) ambition that moves us beyond a commodity mindset and positions us as the trusted advisor to our customers’ brands - helping them create distinctive, sustainable chocolate experiences.

As part of one of three Global CX Centers of Excellence, the Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties shapes and drives the global Commercial Excellence agenda for the Food Manufacturers segment and Specialties category, in close partnership with regional Sales, Marketing, R&D, Chocolate Academy, and Operations.

The role ensures that commercial teams continuously improve Customer Experience across the entire Customer Journey.

The position also collaborates closely with the other CX CoEs (Global Accounts, Gourmet) to deliver a seamless, end to end BC Commercial Excellence journey on cross segment priorities such as outsourcing, productivity, and pricing excellence.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Accelerate Growth across Industrial Accounts and Retailers by supporting key commercial initiatives

• Embed Commercial Excellence through Salesforce adoption, including playbooks, dashboards, and account planning

• Strengthen Strategic Account Planning for FM, Retail & Chains with clear governance and adoption tracking

• Activate Winning Portfolio with customers by partnering closely with Marketing and enabling commercial teams

• Enhance Pricing Excellence by supporting strategic pricing initiatives and improving end‑to‑end pricing processes

• Improve Master Data & Systems to streamline internal workflows and elevate customer experience

• Align with Global Specialties to ensure Commercial Excellence initiatives directly support category growth

• Translate Strategy into Action by converting BC 6–8 initiatives into Commercial Excellence programs within the Customer Journey

• Accelerate Specialties Growth through capability building in solution‑selling and cross‑selling

• Strengthen Strategic Partnerships via standardized SLAs and contract management for FM, Retail & Chain customers

• Advance Pricing Maturity through the Next Level Pricing initiative, improving contract pricing, quotation experience, and value‑in‑use monetization

• Develop Commercial Excellence Academy content in collaboration with the CX Learning team

• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, ensuring consistent updates on innovation, sustainability, quality, and services

• Identify Global Big Bets using Commercial Intelligence and drive corrective actions to support growth

• Provide Targeted Support to Chains and Retail segments as needed

About You

• At least 7 years of experience in senior commercial roles, ideally within global B2B commercial organizations

• Commercial / Sales Excellence expertise, including Key Account Management excellence, CRM governance, commercial capability building, and execution excellence

• Strong experience managing sizeable markets and large customers across multiple route‑to‑market models, particularly with Key Accounts and brand owners

• Demonstrated ability to deliver through cross‑functional collaboration, working effectively across diverse teams and organizational levels

• Knowledge of chocolate, cacao, and specialties categories is a strong plus

• Experience in working in Multi-matrix organization

• University degree, preferably MBA; completion of an Executive Leadership Program is a plus

• Fluent English, plus 1 additional language; German and French are an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo Il futuro di Barry Callebaut si basa sul rafforzamento della fiducia dei clienti durante la navigazione sui mercati di spostamento e sui rapidi cambiamenti tecnologici. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, stiamo affinando un’ambizione unificata Customer Experience (CX) che ci spinge oltre una mentalità delle materie prime e ci posiziona come consulente affidabile per i marchi dei nostri clienti - aiutandoli a creare esperienze di cioccolato distintive e sostenibili. Come parte di uno dei tre Global CX Centers of Excellence, il Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties modella e guida l'agenda globale di eccellenza commerciale per il segmento Food Manufacturers e Specialties categoria, in stretta collaborazione con le vendite regionali, Marketing, R&D, Chocolate Academy e Operazioni. Il ruolo assicura che i team commerciali migliorano continuamente l'esperienza del cliente in tutto il viaggio del cliente. La posizione collabora anche a stretto contatto con gli altri CX CoEs (Global Accounts, Gourmet) per offrire un viaggio di eccellenza commerciale senza soluzione di continuità, fine a fine BC sulle priorità del segmento trasversale come outsourcing, produttività e l'eccellenza dei prezzi. Responsabilità chiave
• Accelerare la crescita tra conti industriali e rivenditori sostenendo iniziative commerciali chiave
• Eccellenza commerciale incorporata attraverso l'adozione di Salesforce, tra cui i playbook, le dashboard e la pianificazione dell'account
• Rafforzare la pianificazione strategica del conto per FM, Retail & Chains con chiara governance e monitoraggio dell'adozione
• Attiva Winning Portfolio con i clienti collaborando strettamente con Marketing e abilitando i team commerciali
• Migliorare l'eccellenza dei prezzi supportando iniziative strategiche di prezzi e migliorando i processi dei prezzi end-to-end
• Migliorare i dati e i sistemi master per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro interni e aumentare l'esperienza del cliente
• Allineare con le specialità globali per garantire che le iniziative di Commercial Excellence supportino direttamente la crescita della categoria
• Traduci la strategia in azione convertendo le iniziative BC 6–8 in programmi di eccellenza commerciale all'interno del Customer Journey
• Accelerare la crescita delle specialità attraverso la creazione di capacità in soluzione-selling e cross-selling
• Rafforzare i partenariati strategici tramite SLA standardizzati e la gestione dei contratti per i clienti FM, Retail & Chain
• Advance Pricing Maturity attraverso l'iniziativa Next Level Pricing, migliorare i prezzi dei contratti, l'esperienza di quotazione e la monetizzazione di valore-in-uso
• Sviluppa contenuti dell'Accademia di Eccellenza Commerciale in collaborazione con il team di apprendimento CX
• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, assicurando aggiornamenti costanti su innovazione, sostenibilità, qualità e servizi
• Identificare Global Big Bets utilizzando l'intelligenza commerciale e guidare azioni correttive per sostenere la crescita
• Fornire il supporto mirato a catene e segmenti di vendita al dettaglio come necessario A proposito di te
• Almeno 7 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali senior, idealmente all'interno di organizzazioni commerciali B2B globali
• Competenza commerciale / vendite Eccellenza, tra cui eccellenza Key Account Management, CRM governance, costruzione di capacità commerciali e eccellenza di esecuzione
• Forte esperienza nella gestione di mercati di grandi dimensioni e di grandi clienti attraverso diversi modelli di route-to-market, in particolare con Key Account e proprietari di marchi
• Dimostrata capacità di fornire attraverso la collaborazione interfunzionale, lavorando in modo efficace attraverso team e livelli organizzativi diversi
• La conoscenza delle categorie di cioccolato, cacao e specialità è un vantaggio forte
• Esperienza nel lavoro nell'organizzazione Multi-matrix
• Laurea universitaria, preferibilmente MBA; il completamento di un Executive Leadership Program è un plus
• Inglese fluente, più 1 lingua aggiuntiva; tedesco e francese sono un vantaggio

Dans le cadre de l'un des trois Global CX Centers of Excellence, le Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties façonne et pilote le programme mondial d'excellence commerciale pour le segment et les spécialités des fabricants d'aliments, en partenariat étroit avec les ventes régionales, le marketing, la R-D, Chocolate Academy et les opérations. Le rôle assure que les équipes commerciales améliorent continuellement l'expérience client dans tout le parcours client. Le poste collabore également étroitement avec les autres CX CoE (Global Accounts, Gourmet) afin d'assurer un parcours continu et final de BC Commercial Excellence sur des priorités intersectorielles telles que l'externalisation, la productivité et l'excellence en matière de prix. Responsabilités clés
• Accélérer la croissance des comptes industriels et des détaillants en appuyant des initiatives commerciales clés
• Intégrer l'excellence commerciale par l'adoption de Salesforce, y compris les livres de jeu, les tableaux de bord et la planification des comptes
• Renforcer la planification stratégique des comptes pour la FM, le commerce de détail et les chaînes grâce à une gouvernance claire et au suivi des adoptions
• Activer le portefeuille gagnant avec les clients en s'associant étroitement au marketing et en permettant aux équipes commerciales
• Améliorer l'excellence en matière de tarification en appuyant les initiatives stratégiques en matière de tarification et en améliorant les processus de tarification de bout en bout
• Améliorer Master Data & Systems pour rationaliser les flux de travail internes et améliorer l'expérience client
• Alignez-vous avec les spécialités mondiales pour assurer des initiatives d'excellence commerciale qui soutiennent directement la croissance des catégories
• Traduire la stratégie en action en convertissant les initiatives BC 6–8 en programmes d'excellence commerciale au sein du parcours client
• Accélérer la croissance des spécialités par le renforcement des capacités dans la vente de solutions et la vente croisée
• Renforcer les partenariats stratégiques grâce à des ALS normalisés et à la gestion des contrats pour les clients FM, Retail & Chain
• Échéance de la fixation des prix à l'avance grâce à l'initiative de fixation des prix de niveau suivant, à l'amélioration de la tarification des contrats, à l'expérience en matière de cotation et à la monétisation de la valeur en utilisation
• Développer le contenu de l'Académie d'excellence commerciale en collaboration avec l'équipe CX Learning
• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, assurant des mises à jour cohérentes sur l'innovation, la durabilité, la qualité et les services
• Identifier les grands paris mondiaux en utilisant le renseignement commercial et prendre des mesures correctives pour soutenir la croissance
• Fournir un soutien ciblé aux chaînes et aux segments de détail au besoin À propos de toi
• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans des rôles commerciaux de haut niveau, idéalement au sein d'organisations commerciales B2B mondiales
• Expertise en gestion de compte clé, gouvernance CRM, renforcement des capacités commerciales et excellence en exécution
• Forte expérience dans la gestion de marchés importants et de grands clients à travers plusieurs modèles de route à marché, en particulier avec Key Accounts et les propriétaires de marques
• Capacité démontrée d'offrir une collaboration interfonctionnelle, en travaillant efficacement entre les diverses équipes et les divers niveaux organisationnels
• Connaissance des catégories chocolat, cacao et spécialités est un plus fort
• Expérience de travail dans l'organisation multi-matrice
• Diplôme universitaire, de préférence MBA; l'achèvement d'un programme de leadership de la direction est un plus
• Anglais fluent, plus 1 langue supplémentaire; l'allemand et le français sont un avantage
